column1: # Canonical product concepts. Search maps a query to a concept and ranks that
# concept's products first, so 'jaja' returns eggs - not chocolate eggs or egg cups.
# H = head-noun rule: <concept> TAB <folded head words, | separated>
# O = override rule:  <concept> TAB <contains patterns> TAB <guard head words ('' = any)>
# All patterns are diacritic-folded lowercase (gg_fold). Overrides apply before H rules.
